design_status: post-hoc sensitivity on already-viewed Stage3 paths
question: Do previously reported current/archive interactions materially depend on integer-ceiling quantile ranks rather than a common ideal rank level?

rank_rules.randomized90: lower=floor((W+1)*.9), upper=ceil((W+1)*.9); choose upper with probability (W+1)*.9-lower; integrate candidate metric values exactly
rank_rules.metric_order: Compute each candidate interval metric, take rank expectation, then phase/path averages; never score averaged width
rank_rules.randomization_scope: Expected randomized procedure, not a realized random interval stream; no Monte Carlo coin draws

analysis.reference: Gaussian D128 A3 interval-score totalJ GRU-minus-TCN at entry and recovery64; original rule, randomized rule, paired rule change
analysis.all_outputs: both families, both phases, all five metrics, both architectures and paired architecture contrast, six components, both rules and paired rule change
analysis.fixed_fit_path: Average all 3 panels x5 paired seeds before common path resampling
analysis.crossed_sensitivity: Resample3 panels,5 shared seed indices,128 common paths; same seed draw broadcast to every sampled panel, all architectures/rules share draws
analysis.pairing: Compute all architecture and rule changes within the same bootstrap replicate
analysis.multiplicity: 97.5% reference intervals are a two-phase approximation within each rule/change series, not joint protection across rank rules or all analyses; all nonreference95% descriptive intervals unadjusted; exercise entirely post-hoc
analysis.no_new_threshold: No claim based on a selected sign, significance threshold, percentage attenuation, or winning configuration; report all changes and failures

execution.overwrite: refuse if output directory already exists

checks: Nonlinear scoring counterexample proves score of expected width is wrong
Every ceiling rank and all five reference metrics reproduce original Stage3
All current/archive/window cells and both decomposition routes retained
All candidate per-path phase metrics saved
Finite-memory agreement checked for lower and upper candidate ranks
Bootstrap compared to independent scalar toy loops
Exact row grids reject missing duplicate and off-grid identities
Frozen dependencies and all model hashes verified before and after
limitations: Same observed Stage3 paths; post-hoc sensitivity, not independent confirmatory evidence
Common90% ideal rank level is an exchangeable continuous-score benchmark, not coverage guarantee for dependent nonstationary neural scores
Randomized90 lowers both original finite-rank levels; it is sensitivity to the rank rule, not unique causal correction or explained-effect percentage
Window changes still alter score count, history span, and empirical-quantile variability
Only3 training panels and5 shared seeds; crossed bootstrap remains descriptive sensitivity
Both route components correlated and order-dependent; no causal mediation fractions
Signed J is not absolute performance or model quality ranking
Coverage deficit averages the positive oracle deficit of each candidate; not positive part after averaging
Exact integration targets expected metrics and omits variability from realizing rank coins
No new financial deployment or trading claims
